provenance.note: Author-provided stand-in for a live LLM extraction response. No live model call is bundled, so the pipeline stays offline and deterministic. The validation loop (schema + source-span/hash + gold diff) treats this JSON exactly as it would a live response; swapping in a provider adapter that sends only the public excerpt + the RuleCandidate schema is a one-function change (see reg_to_check/extractor.py).
provenance.inputs_sent_to_extractor: public manifest excerpt + typed schema instruction only (never IFC, local files, or secrets)
